description: Subject bundles (subject_bundle/0, the subject convention v0, evidencebook#116 design note section 4) and what a verifier makes of each, written by subject_vectors_test.go (EB_WRITE_SUBJECT_VECTORS=1) with VerifySubjectBundle. A valid full form names its level: holder_commitment (the subject_id index's key range proof) or log_prefix (every record from seq 1 to the anchor disclosed). A projection is the holder's assertion. An invalid vector must be refused.

vectors.case: (i) the same with M2 left out of the members: refused, the close counts 2
(i) with the log prefix disclosed: log_prefix
(ii) M2 left out of the index: passes the first level, as the index's limit allows
(ii) the same with the log prefix disclosed: refused, the prefix shows M2
(vi) a projection: two visible members, the protected one absent, holder_assertion
